name: ProPlanet P6
summary: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P6 RO Water Purifier features 8-stage RO purification with Silver Charge Membrane Technology (SCMT) to deliver 100% RO purified, baby-safe drinking water.
intro: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P6 RO Water Purifier features an advanced 8-stage RO purification system with Silver Charge Membrane Technology (SCMT) to deliver 100% RO purified, baby-safe drinking water. Equipped with 45°C warm and 80°C hot water dispensing, a 9.2L storage tank, digital display, and Advanced Recovery Technology™ that saves up to 2X more water, it is an ideal solution for modern homes using borewell, tanker, or mixed water sources.
